text: You use the arrow key to scroll up a bit. You can't believe how much you've already typed into this stupid contraption. What a waste of time.
alt: A huge list of all of the commands that have been given to John. An except: JOHN YOU ARE STUPID. STUPID STUPID DUMB. FOR THE LAST TIME I COMMAnd you to get the cookies boy. mister john, respectfully ask that you please stand up. now sir boy, flee from this boorish rabble post haste. well done, john. polite congratulations. now my civil fellow, i have a well mannered query to ask. john might i bother you for a can opener? fellow john, it appears we have reached an impasse. the opener dilemma remains unsettled, most unfortunately. but it has been a pleasure nonetheless. oh, but thank you. thank you so very very much, dear favorable small primate. i shall take my leave now john. until next time.
